verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing platform, so platform-enforced spend limits are a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents per-card or per-cardholder amount caps over daily, monthly, or all-time windows, nor transaction-count velocity rules. The nearest items are adjacent controls and earn no credit: merchant/MCC blocking, a 3DS rule that forces a challenge above an amount threshold, and credit-line lifecycle management.
